Title: UCP journey — B2B org buyer discovers, links, shops, checks out, and lands on their own cart
Preconditions: vcst-qa on the build pinned in this suite's manifest notes (config/test-suites.json, suite 102) — UCP 3.1006.0-pr-7-612c / Platform 3.1072.0-pr-3108-b6ef / storefront 2.59.0-pr-2467-1951. MCP endpoint {{FRONT_URL}}/ucp/mcp — STOREFRONT host only (Platform host cannot mint a matching-audience token; see suite notes). Token recipe, ambient REST context and the SEARCH_TERM rule are in the suite notes — do not restate them per case. Role: @td(ACME_ADMIN.email) in @td(ORG_ACME.platform_id). This is the ONE case in the suite that must pass end to end for the feature to be considered working — every other case refines one link of it. Cleanup deliberately omits logout_buyer here: this case’s role is a shared fixture also used by other suites in the corpus, and logout_buyer revokes ALL of a buyer’s Platform OAuth sessions ("including other sessions," per its own tool description) — calling it risks silently breaking a concurrently-running sibling suite’s live session.
Test_Data: role_email=@td(ACME_ADMIN.email), role_password={{B2B_USER_PASSWORD}}, store={{STORE_ID}}, org=@td(ORG_ACME.platform_id), <SEARCH_TERM> (live-discover, never hardcode)
Steps:
--- API ---
[HTTP] GET {{FRONT_URL}}/.well-known/ucp
[CAPTURE] discovery.mcp_endpoint
[AUTH] POST {{FRONT_URL}}/connect/token grant_type=password, scope=offline_access, storeId={{STORE_ID}}, username=@td(ACME_ADMIN.email), password={{B2B_USER_PASSWORD}}, resource={{FRONT_URL}}/ucp/mcp
[CAPTURE] access_token
[MCP] tools/call name=link_buyer_identity arguments={store_id:{{STORE_ID}}} (Authorization: Bearer access_token)
[CAPTURE] link_result.buyer_id, link_result.organization_id
[MCP] tools/call name=search_products arguments={store_id:{{STORE_ID}},query:"<SEARCH_TERM>",limit:5} (Authorization: Bearer access_token)
[CAPTURE] first_product.product_id, first_product.price
[MCP] tools/call name=create_cart arguments={store_id:{{STORE_ID}},line_items:[{product_id:first_product.product_id,quantity:1}]} (Authorization: Bearer access_token)
[CAPTURE] cart.id, cart.total
[MCP] tools/call name=checkout_and_handoff arguments={store_id:{{STORE_ID}},cart_id:cart.id,shipping_address:{first_name:"QA",last_name:"Agent",line1:"1 Test Way",city:"Seattle",region:"WA",postal_code:"98101",country_code:"USA"}} (Authorization: Bearer access_token)
[CAPTURE] handoff.continue_url, handoff.checkout.id, handoff.checkout.total
--- STOREFRONT ---
[NAV] handoff.continue_url
[ACT] if the storefront shows the sign-in page (a fresh browser is redirected to /sign-in?returnUrl=/checkout?ucp_resume=…&reauthenticate=1), sign in as @td(ACME_ADMIN.email) with {{B2B_USER_PASSWORD}}
[WAIT] page settles on a /cart/{id}?ucp_handoff=1 URL
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[ADMIN] the cart/checkout persisted with owner=@td(ACME_ADMIN.email) and org=@td(ORG_ACME.platform_id), confirmed via Platform REST GET on the cart id
[CONSOLE] no JS errors on the /cart landing page
[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx on the /cart page load itself; the restore call shows an expected 401 on each anonymous-first attempt — two in a session that must sign in first, one in an already-signed-in session — followed by a 200 authenticated retry (documented client strategy, same pattern as UCPA-015 and UCPA-018 — not a failure signal)
Failure_Signals: 401/403 on any MCP call in the API leg, empty or zero-total cart on arrival, storefront Subtotal differing from the first product price at quantity 1, wrong or missing organization context on the storefront, restore requiring more than one attempt (see UCPA-015 which measures this separately)
Cleanup: [TEARDOWN] remove the created cart via Admin or DELETE /api/carts/{cart.id} if not already consumed by checkout; sign out the storefront session

[STATUS] LINK_1 answers HTTP 200 {SPEC}
[BODY] LINK_1.buyer_id is non-empty {SPEC} -- guard added 2026-11-10 (REG-2026-11-10-1934-MCP triage §2): without a linked buyer the two organization assertions below pass on any empty answer

Title: Checkout snapshot — create_checkout totals agree with the cart it was composed from
Preconditions: vcst-qa on the build pinned in this suite's manifest notes (config/test-suites.json, suite 102) — UCP 3.1006.0-pr-7-612c / Platform 3.1072.0-pr-3108-b6ef / storefront 2.59.0-pr-2467-1951. MCP endpoint {{FRONT_URL}}/ucp/mcp — STOREFRONT host only (Platform host cannot mint a matching-audience token; see suite notes). Token recipe, ambient REST context and the SEARCH_TERM rule are in the suite notes — do not restate them per case. Role: @td(ACME_ADMIN.email). THE CART IS CLEARED FIRST and cleared again on teardown. Two reasons, both measured 2026-09-23: create_cart UPSERTS into the authenticated buyer's existing default cart rather than opening a fresh one (proved by UCPA-028), so without the clear this case reads a cart nobody in this suite composed — observed total 1203699 against an arithmetic expectation of 88700, and the P1 line climbing 8 -> 14 -> 16 across consecutive runs of this very case, i.e. the case was polluting a SHARED fixture account every time it ran. The reset is done with update_cart, not create_cart: create_cart UPSERTS (it raises the quantity of a line already present), whereas update_cart takes the COMPLETE DESIRED STATE of the named cart, so passing exactly one line at quantity 2 makes the cart exactly that regardless of what it held before. Two steps are needed because update_cart requires cart_id (400 invalid_request without it) and no tool returns the default cart id on its own, while create_cart refuses an empty line_items[] (400, "line_items must contain at least one item") — so the bootstrap create_cart resolves the buyer to their one cart and yields its id, and the update_cart that follows sets the state this case asserts on. SINGLE LINE, not two: the second product this case used to add ({{TERM2}}'s SKU) carries a minimum order quantity of 2 and has under 2 in stock on vcst-qa, so create_cart drops the line with a recoverable PRODUCT_MIN_QTY_NOT_AVAILABLE and reports ucp.status success anyway (the same silent-drop shape UCPA-025 owns) — an unconstrained live-discover of "the first two products" is exactly the fixture the SECOND RULE warns about, because it is not constrained on orderability, the one dimension this case is sensitive to. Cleanup deliberately omits logout_buyer: this role is a shared fixture also used by other suites, and logout_buyer revokes ALL of a buyer's Platform OAuth sessions ("including other sessions," per its own tool description). [PRE] A UCP-audience token for each named buyer from OAuth 2.1 authorization-code + PKCE on the STOREFRONT host with resource={{FRONT_URL}}/ucp/mcp (the Playwright lane signs the buyer in through the real consent flow, password typed by NAME; one token per named buyer, minted in turn). {OBSERVED 2026-11-10, vcst-qa, UCP 3.1011.0-pr-13-5de2}: the machine runner's [AUTH role=...] password-grant UCP token is answered 401 identity_required on /ucp/mcp (KB-7BBFAE10; suite-102 notes, VCST-6155 AMENDMENT), so no assertion of the former [MCP-OP] form was ever reached. This case is therefore written as free-form [MCP] / [HTTP] steps (the shape of UCPA-043..057) and routes to the browser lane.
Steps:
[MCP] link_buyer_identity {} with the ACME_ADMIN token -> LINK_1; [CAPTURE] LINKED_BUYER_ID = LINK_1.buyer_id
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/graphql (xapi, anonymous): query { products(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}", first: 1) { items { code } } } -> DISC; [CAPTURE] TERM1 = DISC.data.products.items[0].code
[MCP] search_products {store_id:{{STORE_ID}},query:TERM1,limit:1} with the same token -> SEARCH_1; [CAPTURE] P1_ID = SEARCH_1.products[0].id, P1_PRICE = SEARCH_1.products[0].price.amount
[MCP] create_cart {store_id:{{STORE_ID}},line_items:[{product_id:P1_ID,quantity:1}]} (the bootstrap: it resolves the buyer to their one cart) -> BOOT_1; [CAPTURE] CART_ID = BOOT_1.cart.id
[MCP] update_cart {store_id:{{STORE_ID}},cart_id:CART_ID,line_items:[{product_id:P1_ID,quantity:2}]} (the complete desired state: exactly one line at quantity 2) -> CART_1; [CAPTURE] CART_TOTAL = CART_1.cart.totals.total.amount
[MCP] create_checkout {store_id:{{STORE_ID}},cart_id:CART_ID} -> CO_1
Cross_Layer_Checks: [ADMIN] the persisted cart (Platform REST GET on cart.id) shows the same total and line-item quantities as cart.total/checkout.total captured via MCP — confirms the checkout snapshot isn't just a response-body artifact
Failure_Signals: checkout.cart.total differs from cart.total with no line-item change between the two calls; the clear step leaving line_items non-empty (update_cart no longer taking complete desired state); line_total drifting from unit_price x quantity; subtotal differing from unit_price x quantity; or total differing from subtotal + tax + shipping + payment + fee - discount (a line dropped or mis-summed; or an amount leaking into the total)
Cleanup: [TEARDOWN] none needed for correctness — the case RESETS at the start (update_cart sets the complete desired state), so it is idempotent across runs and leaves the shared fixture's cart holding exactly the one line it asserted on, never an accumulating pile. Do NOT add a logout_buyer: it revokes ALL of this shared role's Platform sessions

Title: Buyer isolation - buyer A cannot read buyer B's cart or order across organizations, and a foreign id is answered like an unknown one
Preconditions: vcst-qa with VirtoCommerce.UCP served as the 'ucp' scope of VirtoCommerce.MCP (versions as reported by GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/modules, never pinned here); store {{STORE_ID}}, storefront {{FRONT_URL}}. Every tool's arguments are taken from its inputSchema in tools/list at run time, not guessed. The pair decides nothing if both belong to one organization (SECOND RULE): the organizations are read from link_buyer_identity and the case is BLOCKED (data gap) when they are equal. B's order is live-discovered (POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/order/customerOrders/search with customerId = B's platform id, newest first, take 1); with none the order rows are BLOCKED - this case creates no order. B's cart is created in-case. Steps:

[MCP] link_buyer_identity {} with TOKEN_B -> LINK_B
[MCP] create_cart with one line item and TOKEN_B -> CART_B
[MCP] link_buyer_identity {} with TOKEN_A -> LINK_A
[MCP] get_cart {cart_id: CART_B} with TOKEN_A -> G_CART_FOREIGN
[MCP] get_cart {cart_id: a random GUID} with TOKEN_A -> G_CART_UNKNOWN
[MCP] list_carts with TOKEN_A -> L_A
[MCP] get_order {id: ORDER_B} with TOKEN_A -> G_ORD_FOREIGN; track_order for ORDER_B's number with TOKEN_A -> T_FOREIGN
[MCP] get_order {id: a random GUID} with TOKEN_A -> G_ORD_UNKNOWN
[MCP] controls: get_cart {CART_B} with TOKEN_B -> G_CART_OWN; get_order {ORDER_B} with TOKEN_B -> G_ORD_OWN
Assertions:
[BODY] LINK_A and LINK_B name different organizations {SPEC} -- the fixture contract: with one organization the case is BLOCKED, never PASS
[BODY] G_CART_OWN returns CART_B and G_ORD_OWN returns ORDER_B {SPEC} -- the controls: the ids are valid and visible to their owner
[BODY] G_CART_FOREIGN returns no line item, total or address of CART_B {BL} -- BL-GQL-004 (d): an authenticated user cannot read another user's cart or order (Forbidden or empty result); and it has the same error code and shape as G_CART_UNKNOWN {SPEC} -- a foreign id is answered as an unknown one inside the buyer's own context (the ownership rule of the UCP README, as cited by UCPO-016 and UCPA-050: not found within that buyer context), because a different answer would confirm that the id exists
[BODY] L_A does not contain CART_B {BL} -- BL-GQL-004 (d)

Failure_Signals: No JSON-RPC response within 10s, 5xx on /admin/mcp, /ucp/mcp or api/mcp/*, a token or credential accepted where a 401/403 is expected, response body empty or not JSON-RPC
